text: Appeal of Order to Comply (March 29, 2018) for 5600 Sheppard Avenue East

Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the order to comply, dated March 29, 2018, for 5600 Sheppard Avenue East, Folder No: 18 134411 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to July 30, 2018, to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
